kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the tables; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The three-axis family grid (envelope, genome shape, size poles) wired to M22's envelope rule; the herpes roster reorganized on the latency axis (trigeminal, sacral, dorsal root, B cell, mononuclear cell); the two-cell EBV split (infected B cell vs reactive cytotoxic T cell); the Monospot sign as the EBV/CMV discriminator; and the opportunist set mapped to the immunocompromised host — labeled as integrations.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two tables side by side without the grid axes or the latency synthesis; these are KYP's design.

notes: Census: p183 2 rasters (molluscum bodies A, pharyngitis B); p184 0 rasters (the A-J markers print here, the photographs print on p185 — the cross-page figure convention); p185 13 rasters vs 11 identified markers (A-J gallery + the gray Tzanck A) — the 2-image discrepancy documented as gallery sub-tiling. The banner typo MICROCIOLOGY prints on books 161-163; the VLM census normalized it twice differently (MICROBIOLOGY on p185, MICROBIOLOOY on p183) — the text layer is authoritative. p184's VZV route text merges with the notes column at line 63; the VZV latency note emits at the page end after the footer (150-155); the EBV and CMV route columns emit as multi-line blocks; the parvovirus row's arrow chain carries text-layer control markers stripped by norm(). FA's printed mnemonics (Pox is out of the box; JC Junky Cerebrum / BK Bad Kidney; Must be 21 to drink Beer in a Barr; Roseola fever-first-Rosy-later; I CAMe to see the rhino) are quoted in the table blocks for verification only.
